mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The effect is continuous and non-thresholded.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 25th percentile) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, monetary tightening compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In labor market weakness (UNRATE > 4.0%) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the economy enters a recessionary phase, triggering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in the condition (UNRATE > 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%), central banks tighten policy, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate cuts and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low HOUST periods (HOUST < 1500) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction (INDPRO < 100) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%), the economy is in a recession, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy stimulus.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in the condition (INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 4.0) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic activity, reducing the risk of recession and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The effect is continuous and non-thresholded.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high HOUST periods (HOUST > 75th percentile) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, reducing recession risk and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The effect is continuous and non-thresholded.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low UNRATE periods (UNRATE < 25th percentile) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
